seen./tmp/opencode/wb-shadow/content/storytim: Goals: a-nut (one big brown nut in Nan's open hand, close up), a-nose (Nan touches her own nose with one finger and laughs), hello-i-am-ben (Ben hangs his school bag on a hook and waves; Pat's bag moves on the floor).

defects: the fingers on the hand that holds the acorn are short and partly merged; the hand reads as a lump under the nut
long eyelashes added; the cast Nan has no eyelashes
color.notes: Nan matches the cast: buns with red ties, orange star shirt, red shorts, white shoes. Soft round 3D chibi look kept. The big brown nut sits in her open hand, so the goal shows. The 3D page is a close-up; the Muse page pulls the camera back and shows the full body with wide white margins, so the size and camera of the layout change. No mouth or eye defect. No text or logo. Rated G.

defects: thin hairline stroke; much thinner than the thick even stroke of the 3D line art

line.notes: Lines are closed, black on white, with no gray, no speck, and no text. The stroke is thin and uneven, and the many fine interior lines are hard for a five-year-old to color. At 1920 x 1280 the lines would get thinner still when scaled to the 4000 x 3000 print size. The drawing matches the Muse color picture and the goal.

color.notes: Ben matches the cast: brown hair, blue T-shirt, dark blue shorts, grey shoes. The waving hand is open with separated fingers; the side hand is a clean relaxed hand. Mouth and eyes are clean and even. The green school bag hangs on the hook and the red bag sits on the floor, so the goal shows. The pose, framing, and camera match the 3D page. The 3D chibi look stays. Small change: Muse adds eyelashes that the cast Ben does not have; I did not count this as a defect. No text or logo. Rated G.
